headline: 本周影剧：野兽之心与龙族领跑
summary: 今日影剧速递：电影方面《野兽之心》《生化危机：爆发夜》等本周热作领跑；剧集方面《龙族》《瑞克和莫蒂》等持续热播，待映片单中《复仇者联盟5》《猫鼬》备受期待。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《野兽之心》《忘却之岛》《爱情假说》《黄金时段》《生化危机：爆发夜》本周领跑。
industryHighlights.en: Movie heat: Beast Heart, Island of Oblivion, The Love Hypothesis, Primetime and Resident Evil: Outbreak Night lead this week.

industryHighlights.text: 剧集热播：《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》《梦魇绝镇》《黑色丽人》持续吸睛。
industryHighlights.en: TV hits: The Rookie, Rick and Morty, House of the Dragon, From and Black Beauty continue to draw viewers.

industryHighlights.text: 待映关注：《猫鼬》《复仇者联盟5》《挖掘者》《另一个妈妈》《不存在的罪人》排队登场。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films: Mongoose, Avengers 5, Digger, The Other Mother and The Inexistent Sinner are queued for release.

headlineEn: This Week in Film & TV: Beast Heart and Dragon Lead
summaryEn: Today's film and TV digest: movie hits such as Beast Heart and Resident Evil: Outbreak Night lead the week, while House of the Dragon and Rick and Morty stay hot on TV; upcoming films like Avengers 5 and Mongoose are highly anticipated.
